newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sees Hachette final Ruch bid Monday.
newsitem.headline: Poland sees Hachette final Ruch bid Monday.

text.p: The Polish government expects France's press distributor Hachette to present a final bid for the large state-owned news-stand chain Ruch SA on Monday, an official from the tresury ministry press office said.
"Today, on December 16, Hachette is to put forward a final offer...They have time until midnight," Maciej Chojnacki told Reuters.
The ministry has earlier granted Hachette the right to be the sole bidder for Ruch until last Friday.
It has said that unless a Hachette offer proved satisfactory it could annul the current tender for the Ruch sale, launch a new one or seek a different solution.
Hachette, leading the consortium involving several Polish firms, wants to buy a strategic stake in Ruch, which netted 16.2 million zlotys on sales of 2.7 billion zlotys in 1995.
Ruch controls about 65 percent of Poland's press distribution with about 17,000 outlets.
